SELECT CatalogClients.Code AS Code, CatalogClients.Description AS Description, CatalogClients.LastName AS LastName, CatalogClients.FirstName AS FirstName, CatalogClients.SecondName AS SecondName, CatalogClients.FullName AS FullName, CAST(CASE WHEN CatalogClients.Sex IN (&qClientSex) THEN &qSexMale ELSE &qSexFemale END AS NUMBER(3, 0)) AS Sex, CatalogClients.Citizenship AS Citizenship, CatalogClients.Phone AS Phone, CatalogClients.Fax AS Fax, CatalogClients.EMail AS EMail, CatalogClients.EMailAdditional AS EMailAdditional, CatalogClients.DateOfBirth AS DateOfBirth, CatalogClients.IdentityDocumentType AS IdentityDocumentType, CatalogClients.IdentityDocumentSeries AS IdentityDocumentSeries, CatalogClients.IdentityDocumentNumber AS IdentityDocumentNumber, CatalogClients.IdentityDocumentIssueDate AS IdentityDocumentIssueDate, CatalogClients.IdentityDocumentValidToDate AS IdentityDocumentValidToDate, CatalogClients.IdentityDocumentIssuedBy AS IdentityDocumentIssuedBy, CatalogClients.Language AS Language, CatalogClients.ClientType AS ClientType, CatalogClients.ClientType.Code AS ClientTypeCode, CatalogClients.DiscountCard.DiscountType AS DiscountCardDiscountType, CatalogClients.IsInWhiteList AS VIP, CatalogClients.MilitaryRank AS Rank, AccCount.AccommodationCount AS AccommodationCount, ReservCount.ReservationCount AS ReservationCount, ClientTags.Tag AS Tag, CatalogClients.NoSMSDelivery AS NoSMSDelivery, CatalogClients.RefusedToParticipateInLoyaltyProgram AS RefusedToParticipateInLoyaltyProgram FROM Catalog.Clients AS CatalogClients LEFT JOIN (SELECT COUNT(Accommodation.Ref) AS AccommodationCount, Accommodation.Guest AS Guest FROM Document.Accommodation AS Accommodation WHERE NOT Accommodation.DeletionMark AND Accommodation.Posted AND Accommodation.AccommodationStatus.IsActive
GROUP BY Accommodation.Guest) AS AccCount ON CatalogClients.Ref = AccCount.Guest LEFT JOIN (SELECT COUNT(Reservation.Ref) AS ReservationCount, Reservation.Guest AS Guest FROM Document.Reservation AS Reservation WHERE NOT Reservation.DeletionMark AND Reservation.Posted AND Reservation.ReservationStatus.ShowInClientsSearchForm
GROUP BY Reservation.Guest) AS ReservCount ON CatalogClients.Ref = ReservCount.Guest LEFT JOIN InformationRegister.ClientTags AS ClientTags ON CatalogClients.Ref = ClientTags.Client AND (ClientTags.Tag = &qTag) WHERE NOT CatalogClients.IsFolder AND (CatalogClients.DeletionMark = FALSE OR &qShowDeleted) AND (&qAuthor = VALUE(Catalog.Employees.EmptyRef) OR &qAuthor <> VALUE(Catalog.Employees.EmptyRef) AND CatalogClients.Author = &qAuthor) AND (&qClientsListIsEmpty OR NOT &qClientsListIsEmpty AND CatalogClients.Ref IN (&qClientsList)) AND (NOT &qTagIsFilled OR &qTagIsFilled AND ClientTags.Tag = &qTag) AND (NOT &qClientTypeIsFilled OR &qClientTypeIsFilled AND CatalogClients.ClientType IN HIERARCHY (&qClientType))

SELECT Accommodations.AccommodationStatus AS Status, Accommodations.GuestGroup AS GuestGroup, Accommodations.GuestGroup.Description AS GuestGroupDescription, Accommodations.CheckInDate AS CheckInDate, Accommodations.CheckOutDate AS CheckOutDate, Accommodations.Room AS Room, Accommodations.RoomType AS RoomType, Accommodations.RoomRate AS RoomRate, Accommodations.AccommodationType AS AccommodationType, Accommodations.Ref AS Document, Accommodations.Remarks AS Remarks, Accommodations.Hotel AS Hotel FROM Document.Accommodation AS Accommodations WHERE CASE WHEN &qClient = UNDEFINED THEN FALSE ELSE Accommodations.Guest = &qClient END AND Accommodations.AccommodationStatus.IsActive AND Accommodations.Posted AND (&qCheckUserRightsForHotel AND Accommodations.Hotel IN (&qAllowedHotels) OR NOT &qCheckUserRightsForHotel)
UNION ALL
SELECT Reservations.ReservationStatus, Reservations.GuestGroup, Reservations.GuestGroup.Description, Reservations.CheckInDate, Reservations.CheckOutDate, Reservations.Room, Reservations.RoomType, Reservations.RoomRate, Reservations.AccommodationType, Reservations.Ref, Reservations.Remarks, Reservations.Hotel FROM Document.Reservation AS Reservations WHERE CASE WHEN &qClient = UNDEFINED THEN FALSE ELSE Reservations.Guest = &qClient END AND Reservations.ReservationStatus.ShowInClientsSearchForm = TRUE AND Reservations.Posted AND (&qCheckUserRightsForHotel AND Reservations.Hotel IN (&qAllowedHotels) OR NOT &qCheckUserRightsForHotel)
ORDER BY CheckInDate
